name: Portfolio Management RL Robustness Benchmark
description: Deep Reinforcement Learning approaches to Online Portfolio Selection have grown in popularity in recent years. The sensitive nature of training Reinforcement Learning agents implies a need for extensive efforts in market representation, behavior objectives, and training processes, which have often been lacking in previous works. We propose a training and evaluation process to assess the performance of classical DRL algorithms for portfolio management. We found that most Deep Reinforcement Learning algorithms were not robust, with strategies generalizing poorly and degrading quickly during backtesting.
reputation: A niche academic benchmark used to evaluate robustness of DRL approaches for portfolio management; moderate adoption in research on financial RL.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; high variance and sensitivity to training details and market regime; risk of backtest leakage and overfitting; limited reproducibility across environments and seeds.
